ranked.headline: Models of RNA measurement structure recover cell types, isoforms and rare subtypes
ranked.summary: Late-2025 preprints and publications extend RNA-seq modeling to rare subtype discovery, deconvolution, isoform resolution and spatial reconstruction.

ranked.headline: Lineage sampling bias in primers, metadata, and cohorts shapes microbial inference
ranked.summary: Recent studies show that primer design, public metadata, and sampling frames each restrict which taxa are observed before inference begins.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based deep learning predicts protein binding, interactions and allergenicity
ranked.summary: Sequence-only and learned-embedding models now predict binding affinity, interactions and function, with growing attention to interpretability.

ranked.headline: Omics tools embed statistical validation and benchmarking into analysis workflows
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published package target error control, computational efficiency and reproducibility across regulatory, splicing, imaging and…

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict regulatory activity and 3D chromatin from DNA sequence
ranked.summary: Pretrained sequence models are now paired with Hi-C data and standardized benchmarks to predict cell type-specific gene expression and chromatin organization.

ranked.headline: Dynamic models infer cell-state transitions from temporally resolved single-cell data
ranked.summary: Minute-scale single-cell profiling (ChronoSeq, ~7-minute resolution) now supports dynamic models beyond descriptive embeddings.

ranked.headline: Graph neural networks and embeddings predict molecular and protein interactions
ranked.summary: Graph-based deep models now span host-pathogen protein interactions, drug-target potency, CNS penetration and allergenicity across preprints and publications.

ranked.headline: Gapless T2T Korean reference and population multiomic data extend genome resources
ranked.summary: Haplotype-resolved T2T assemblies for Korean and cattle genomes, plus 10,239 Korean 30x genomes, extend long-read references to population scale.

ranked.headline: Multi-omic metabolic models link regulatory circuits to cancer and gut disease
ranked.summary: Multi-omic metabolic models now scale to pan-cancer atlases, microbiome-wide reconstructions, and subject-specific genome-scale models.

ranked.headline: Generative and transport models recover cell dynamics and unmeasured gene expression
ranked.summary: Autoencoders paired with optimal transport and Schrödinger bridges now link unpaired single-cell snapshots to dynamics and spatial profiles.

ranked.headline: Sequence and nucleosome determinants jointly shape chromatin structure and accessibility
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair physics-based chromatin simulation with sequence models of accessibility and CpG methylation-dependent protein-DNA binding.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models link genomic variants to expression, splicing, and mutation rates
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark variant calling and splice predictors while extending DNA language models to diploid, zygosity-aware inputs.

ranked.headline: Computational models predict toxicity, promiscuity, and kinase-substrate relationships
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published tool couple curated biomedical data with prediction and ranking, adding explainability and audit layers.

ranked.headline: Attention models decode brain recordings for speech, emotion and language alignment
ranked.summary: Cross-attention and shared-space alignment are being applied to EEG, EMG and ECoG to improve cross-subject decoding and LLM encoding.

ranked.headline: Protein language models guide antimicrobial peptide mining and sequence redesign
ranked.summary: Sequence-based and structure-aware deep models now screen metagenomic-scale protein sequence space for antimicrobial peptides and functional redesign.

ranked.headline: Input selection and fusion strategies govern biomedical ML prognostic performance
ranked.summary: Recent studies show weak added modalities can degrade recurrence-free survival accuracy, making input composition a central determinant of model performance.

ranked.headline: Genomic data reveal domestication history, duplication dating and inherited methylation
ranked.summary: Expanded genome sampling and simulation now separate demographic from duplication and epigenetic signals in evolutionary inference.

ranked.headline: Adaptive tokenization and KV-cache compression extend genomic language model capabilities
ranked.summary: Recent preprints show genomic language models exhibit in-context learning and scale inference via learned tokenization and KV-cache compression.

ranked.headline: Graph and deep learning models predict biological entity interactions and sites
ranked.summary: Recent items couple graph-structured context with learned classifiers across epidemiological, molecular, and drug-related prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Network methods prioritize gene modules, evaluated by causal and enrichment criteria
ranked.summary: Recent preprints add causal and enrichment-based validation to network methods for prioritizing gene regulatory and disease modules.

ranked.headline: Learned models annotate regulatory elements and prioritize functional variants
ranked.summary: Recent papers apply language models and CNNs to interpret non-coding, rare, and plant genomic variants and annotations.

ranked.headline: Learned latent encodings of brain connectivity for dynamics, seizures, and connectomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints tailor latent and graph encodings of connectivity to downstream goals such as seizure detection and connectome analysis.

ranked.headline: SIMD and GPU kernels accelerate alignment and simulation in sequence analysis tools
ranked.summary: Recent tools pair GPU and SIMD alignment kernels with command-line interfaces for large microbial, metagenomic, and genome-scale sequence workloads.

ranked.headline: Reduced representations and ensemble analyses for biomolecular dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications introduce open-source tools for intrinsic dimension, coarse-grained sampling, and ensemble flexibility analysis.

ranked.headline: Objective-conditioned generators for 3D molecules and peptides
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple pocket, lead, and reward conditioning directly into generative design loops for targets including ATP5A and CBL-B.

ranked.headline: Evaluating predicted protein and PROTAC ternary complex models against MD references
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply MD references, Markov state models, and energy matrices to score structural models of complexes and binding.

ranked.headline: Models of learning and decisions reproduce behavioral and spiking-circuit dynamics
ranked.summary: Network models constrained by spiking circuits, reaction times, and learning rules are now being fit to behavioral and neural data.

ranked.headline: Python and GUI tools standardize calibration and hybrid modelling of biological systems
ranked.summary: Open-source tools now combine multi-lab data integration, Bayesian calibration and hybrid modelling in accessible, inspectable software.

ranked.headline: Open-source LLM agents translate natural language into genomic and kinetic model queries
ranked.summary: Locally deployable open-source LLMs now mediate conversational access to genomic annotations, cohort metadata, and kinetic model repositories.

ranked.headline: Delays, criticality and beat frequencies govern neural oscillatory synchronization
ranked.summary: Coupled-oscillator and spiking models now offer mechanistic accounts of how network size, delays, and frequency allocation shape synchrony.

ranked.headline: Generative priors reconstruct 3D shapes from undersampled cryo-EM, AFM and partial data
ranked.summary: Three November 2025 preprints pair generative or multi-fidelity neural priors with undersampled cryo-EM, AFM, and partial-observation data.

ranked.headline: Plasmid energetic costs are added to a flux model of probiotic E. coli Nissle 1917
ranked.summary: Flux models are increasingly extended with plasmid energetic costs and multi-omics integration to inform microbial production design.
